OBSIDIAN_RUNTIME_MODE.description: Runtime contract. live requires OBSIDIAN_API_KEY; headless modes require OBSIDIAN_VAULT.

OBSIDIAN_API_KEY.description: Obsidian Local REST API key. Required only in live mode and in hybrid when live REST tools are needed.

OBSIDIAN_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the Obsidian Local REST API plugin.

OBSIDIAN_VAULT.description: Local vault path. Required for headless modes and for hybrid without OBSIDIAN_API_KEY.

OBSIDIAN_CACHE_SOURCE.description: Cache refresh source. auto prefers filesystem when a vault path is available.

OBSIDIAN_SHARED_CACHE_DB_PATH.description: Optional SQLite cache path. For real-vault validation, keep it outside the synced vault.

OBSIDIAN_VAULT_EXCLUDE_PATTERNS.description: Comma- or newline-separated gitignore-style vault exclusions.

MCP_AUTH_MODE.description: Enable auth for HTTP deployments beyond localhost.

MCP_AUTH_SECRET_KEY.description: JWT secret. Must be at least 32 characters when MCP_AUTH_MODE=jwt.

SMART_ENV_DIR.description: Path to the Smart Connections .smart-env directory for semantic search.

QUERY_EMBEDDER.description: Query embedder provider: auto, ollama, or openai.
